History

Sweeney is an always open and transparent residential design-build remodeling firm that caters to homeowner professionals in Dane County, specifically Madison, Stoughton, Fitchburg, Maple Bluff, McFarland, Middleton, Monona, Oregon, Shorewood Hills, Sun Prairie, Verona, and Waunakee.

Specialized in the remodeling of beautiful kitchens and baths, basements and additions, every project is expertly designed and built utilizing a team of experts who are reliable, fun-loving and easy to work with.

Started in 1954 as a people-centered business, Sweeney today is one of the most trusted names in remodeling, garnering gushing reviews for stunning work, award-winning design, and complete transparency and accountability. Our values guide our decision-making, and encompass the philosophy by which we operate.

How do we do it? By carefully guiding homeowners through a proprietary design-build remodeling process, ensuring homeowners are informed, engaged and 100% satisfied with the end result.

The Sweeney Way

Working with Sweeney on your home remodel means forming a lasting relationship with a trusted local contractor, one who seamlessly combines their highly trained internal team with a reliable network of skilled specialists to bring about swift problem resolution, unvarnished advice, predictable project management, and expert craftsmanship. This ensures your home remodel delights your senses and meets all of your exacting needs, from design through construction.

MISSION / WHY WE EXIST:

We serve Dane County homeowners with the best remodeling experience possible. The value we create ensures peace of mind for our clients and the homes we improve provide the stage where family memories evolve. Lifelong relationships will be the result of our dedication to excellence.

VISION / WHAT WE STRIVE FOR:

With a 60+ year history in the Madison area, the Sweeney name is one of the most trusted names in the remodeling industry. The Sweeney name is synonymous with honesty, transparency, an ability to listen, do what they say they’re going to do, raise questions and identify potential issues upfront.

“I hired the Sweeney team to make minor improvements to my home. I really appreciated Allison’s assistance in picking out colors for paint and carpeting. I love the carpet texture and how it creates patterns with a vacuum cleaner. I would have been lost without Allison’s expertise! I really love the two accent walls and enjoyed the professionalism of Jamie and his painting skills. My remodeling project grew to include ceiling and roof repairs due to a leaky roof, and I was impressed with how the Sweeney team fixed the problem in a timely manner. I also appreciated Jon and Rich’s excellent communication and due diligence throughout my entire project.”

- Fred W., Madison, WI

“We have had Sweeney remodel our kitchen, bathrooms, recreation room and other projects. We have been very satisfied with every project over the past 15 years.”

- Susan F., Madison, WI

“We have used Sweeney multiple times for design/build. They initially appear to be more expensive but their price includes all the unexpected details. If your project is too big for them they will let you know and recommend others. Highly recommend!”

- Karen D., Madison, WI

“This past fall, I contracted with Sweeney Design Remodel to do two projects at my home. One was replacement of the large five-light window in the living room over the garage. The other was to replace the iron railings by my entry stairs with new cable and wood railings and replace the carpeting on the stairs and lay hardwood flooring at the head of the stairs and down the hall. These projects are now complete.

I write because I want you to know first that the two young men who were overseers of these projects did an exemplary job. I was impressed initially by the ground work before anything was done. Individuals from each of the disciplines involved in this project were brought together at my home so they could confer with each other about what was to be done and in what sequence so that the projects would run smoothly. Second, when the first of these two young men moved on to his own business, he was replaced with another who saw the projects to completion. Both of these guys were not only knowledgeable and efficient, they were wonderfully thoughtful and caring which brought me back to my earliest experiences working with you, because that kind of thoughtfulness and caring has kept me coming back to Sweeney.

Ryan is a very special person and an excellent craftsman, if one is to judge by the wooden hand rails on the stairs. He worked so hard on this to make it perfect….and it is. He is so conscientious, caring not only about the big things but the small ones. The project ran right up to Christmas which was a bit frustrating but made the less so because he truly cared and did his best to make things right for me. He even helped me assemble my new Moravian star which hangs above my front door!

The project is a testament to the quality work of Sweeney Design Remodel!”

- Marian E., Madison, WI

“We are pleased with the conscientious work of Ryan and Kerry. Ryan especially has made an extra effort to communicate with us, other Marina residents, and the sub contractors that have been involved so far. Both Ryan and Kerry are very careful in protecting our condo and the common areas of the Marina.  We are off to a good start. Thanks for following up with Jean and I today.“

-Melissa S., Madison, WI

“Just a quick note to say thanks for your company’s service. Your people have been just outstanding to work with. I would like to give a special recognition for Pete Knudson. He has gone up and above to complete this project in the expected quality and has really worked the system to get me on the road.”

-Doug R., Waunakee, WI

“Sweeney did a fantastic job with our basement remodel. They were responsive, thorough, and our basement turned out great. Ryan in particular was pleasant to work with and had a remarkable attention to detail. They were particularly attentive to safety during covid as well. This remodel went as well as a home remodeling project can go.”

“Greetings Mr. Sweeney,

I just wanted to take the time to let you know how much I appreciate your company and your team. We have used your services at AXO for many years now and I can not say enough to let you know how much you are appreciated in so many ways.

Starting with Jeff Darga coming in to get our wants/needs taken care of and getting everything lined up. Jeff is a very pleasant man with a lot of knowledge. He is always pleasant no matter how seemingly unfamiliar some of our Board ladies are with how the work is timed, planned, and executed. Jeff keeps smiling and gently lets them know the facts.

Moving on to Pat and Pete, the small but mighty team we have now. They have been absolutely amazing. The work on the columns is moving along. Then I find out it’s only Pat and Pete…how are these two guys going to do this without more people? Well, they thought things out, investigated things, and came up with quite a plan. I have almost had a few coronary attacks along the way but they are amazing, doing things very safely, and made it through the intense heat last week. I just can’t say enough as to how happy and amazed I have been with their genius ideas and hard work.

Rich…his oversight of the project and dealing with the delivery of the columns has been wonderful.

Matt, who I know is now on his own, came to us through his time with you. He started here very young working alongside his dad. They did amazing things here together. He has put his heart and soul into our building and I know he will always do a good job here as he loves this house.

I have been with AXO for 32 years and I look forward to the summer to work with the Sweeney group as they are all like family here. I know I can trust everyone that comes in to do a great job, and they “look out for me” if I have any problems. I know if Jeff has someone come here they are a good worker and they are trustworthy. The crew has a passion and pride in our house and it shows.

Alpha Chi Omega

The Sweeney Metronome Award

The word “Metronome” is derived from ancient Greek which means “to measure”, “I manage” or “I lead”. This Greek definition speaks well to what the award has come to symbolize at Sweeney Design Remodel.

1. “To Measure” illustrates an employee’s ability to accurately perform their job in a consistent manner.

2. “I Manage” is a reflection of an employee’s skill and effort in being efficient in performing their duties and by accomplishing those duties using a team effort.

3. “I Lead” signifies the ability and willingness of an employee to actively seek new and better methods in ways that improve our company.

This award is presented bi-annually to the person whom the last recipient feels most personifies these qualities at that point in time.

Congratulations to Brett Clarke, our most recent Metronome Award Winner!

Design and Project Development Process
PHASE 1—PRE-DESIGN

Your remodeling experience with Sweeney begins with an initial 30-minute phone call where we talk openly about your needs, challenges with your space, budgetary requirements, and hopeful timeline. If this preliminary conversation is aligned with your thoughts and direction we schedule a site visit, in your home, where we delve deeper into your needs, the existing conditions and project scope.

Upon agreement of a realistic scope of work and preliminary budget, our project developers meet with the design and estimating teams to develop a design agreement (architectural and interior design documents & selections) and Comparative Remodeling Analysis (CRA) that provides you with the assurance of a realistic breakdown of budgetary items that will go into your remodel based on our company’s historical data.

PHASE 2—DESIGN DEVELOPMENT

Upon signing the design agreements, you will be guided through the design process— where the fun begins. Starting with on-site field research of your home’s existing condition, and receiving your completed survey responses, we take photographs and measurements of the space. We also begin developing your architectural drawings and start the selections process.

As part of the design phase, you work closely with our design team and are guided through a selection process to identify finishes that fit your functional needs, design style and budget.

After the architectural drawings and all selections and products are selected, we schedule a subcontractor/vendor walk through of your home. Unique to Sweeney, this allows you the assurance of a working with a deep team of specialists who offer their expertise on your project right from the beginning—collaborating on issues and providing creative input on your project so as to prevent future surprises, unexpected delays and budget overruns.

PHASE 3—PRE-CONSTRUCTION

Our estimating team assembles all subcontractor/vender labor and materials, along with Sweeney labor and management, into a contract. This contract is based on your project’s architectural drawings and product selections.

Upon approval of your detailed plans and specifications, Sweeney starts the permitting process, orders the products and materials, and develops a project timeline or schedule. During this time, we will set up a pre-construction walkthrough meeting with you, our field project manager, and the lead carpenter who is assigned to your project.

PHASE 4—CONSTRUCTION

Work begins on your home remodeling project. Our project coordinator and lead carpenter assigned to your project work collaboratively with the subcontractors and venders to ensure no detail is overlooked and your project begins and ends on schedule.

And, your project doesn’t end there. We take pride in our workmanship and are committed to delivering the best possible remodeling experience possible, standing by our product and backing our work with an extended one-year warranty.

Behind the Design-Build Process

Join us as we take you through our signature design-build remodeling process—the seamless, collaborative approach that makes luxury home renovations easier, more predictable, and more enjoyable for discerning homeowners in Dane County. From the first conversation to the final reveal, learn how Sweeney Design Remodel brings clarity, craftsmanship, and thoughtful design to every project. In this video, you’ll see how we:

Start with open communication to understand your lifestyle, goals, and vision
Develop tailored architectural and interior design plans that reflect your style
Coordinate every detail—from selections to structure—with one dedicated team
Execute construction with precision, professionalism, and respect for your home
Deliver beautiful, functional spaces you’ll love for years to come

Whether you’re remodeling a kitchen, bathroom, addition, or whole home, our integrated process eliminates guesswork, reduces unexpected issues, and keeps your priorities front and center from start to finish.

Design-Build Process in Madison, WI: The Right Choice for Home Remodels

by Sweeney Design Remodel | Aug 21, 2019 | Blog, Design-Build Process | 0 comments

You’ve done your research and gathered some great ideas for your home remodeling project. The next step is to hire a Design-Build company to bring your ideas to life.

Traditionally, when owners are looking to remodel their home (or build a new one), they utilize a process known as Design-Bid-Build (DBB). Using this process, an architect or designer and a contractor are hired separately. First, an owner hires a professional to put together a design based on their needs and wants. The final design is then used to receive bids from various contractors. In many cases, once service providers have been selected, the owner serves as the middleman between the designer and the contractor.

On the other hand, Design-Build companies offer both design and construction services under one contract. This method of construction is showing the most growth both with residential and non-residential construction projects. 

So, what makes Design-Build the process of choice for home remodeling projects?

Let’s highlight the benefits of Design-Build at each step of our project development process.

 

Stage 1: Pre-Design

This stage includes initial discussions around your needs, budgets, and timelines. Included in this step is a Comparative Remodeling Analysis that sets realistic expectations for a remodeling budget. The budget is set with the help of historical data. This stage ends with a design agreement in place.

DESIGN-BUILD ADVANTAGE:

The owner communicates ideas, budgets, and preferred timelines to one company instead of to the designer and contractor separately. This decreases the likelihood of inconsistent information being shared among the parties involved.

The Comparative Remodeling Analysis will give you a better sense of the total remodel cost as opposed to looking at design and construction costs separately. Homeowners will have an easier time tracking one budget instead of two. In fact, Project Managers assigned to the remodeling project will play a significant role in managing the overall budget.

 

Stage 2: Design Development

In this second stage, design professionals draw up conceptual drawings based on on-site research and the survey completed by the owner. Using these drawings, vendors and/or subcontractors conduct a walk-through and give feedback on your design choices.

DESIGN-BUILD ADVANTAGE: 

Working together with both design professionals and subcontractors/vendors simultaneously ensures that owners get valuable feedback from the appropriate team member in a timely manner. As a result, there is a higher likelihood that timelines are adhered to and quality is uncompromised during the process. Any necessary changes based on the team’s feedback can be implemented quickly without waiting for multiple approvals. In the Design-Bid-Build process, the approvals would be coming from multiple people from different companies. 

 

Stage 3: Pre-construction:

Once owners have finalized and signed off on their design plans, the company will begin gathering permits, ordering materials, and scheduling the timeline. During this stage, the remodeling project will be assigned a Project Manager.

DESIGN-BUILD ADVANTAGE: 

Because there will be one point of contact, the risk of miscommunication about materials being used, altered timelines, or design changes will be minimized. 

As materials are being ordered, it will be important to carefully track costs during this stage. Owners will be spared the minutiae of tracking every construction and design line item in the overall budget. The Project Manager takes charge of detailed budget tracking. In the long run, this could result in cost savings for the owner.

 

Stage 4: Construction

In this stage, the Project Manager becomes the owners’ main point of contact as work commences on the remodeling project. The assigned Project Manager will become very familiar with the details of the project and work. The Project Manager will ensure everything is running smoothly and within budget without compromising the timeline.

DESIGN-BUILD ADVANTAGE: 

The transition to the construction phase will be efficient as the entire bid process is eliminated when working with a Design-Build home remodeling company. This shortens the overall project timeline.

If by chance an unexpected issue does occur during the construction process, the designer and contractors will work together to find a solution. Because they are working together as one team, there is no blame placed on an individual member of the team. Instead, there is shared accountability. Everyone on the remodel project team will work towards the successful completion of a high-quality remodeling project.

At Sweeney Design Remodel, we are proud of our team of designers and contractors. Our values are the foundation of all our projects. Contact us to schedule a consultation with our talented designers. We look forward to helping you remodel your home to better fit your lifestyle.

Kitchen Remodeling FAQs
Do I Need to Move Out During a Kitchen Remodel?

In most cases, you can remain in your home during a kitchen remodel. However, you should plan for a period of disruption.

There will be noise, dust, limited access to the kitchen, and temporary interruptions to water, electricity, or gas service, particularly during demolition and rough-in phases.

Some homeowners choose temporary housing to simplify daily routines. Others prefer to stay and set up a temporary kitchen with essentials such as a microwave, small appliances, and a dishwashing station, while relying on simple meals or outdoor cooking.

The best decision depends on:

The scope of your remodel
The length of utility interruptions
Whether structural changes are involved
Your household schedule and tolerance for construction activity

During the planning phase, your design-build team should outline what to expect at each stage so you can make an informed and confident decision for your family.
